content: If yu tok gudwei langa enibodi hu rili wail, wal im garra jidan kwaitbala, bat if yu tok rafwei langa enibodi, wal im garra jidan brabli einggriwan.
Ola pipul hu sabi blanga tok gudbalawei meigim najalot pipul wandi sabi mowa, bat detlot silibala pipul oldei tok rabishwei.
Wal YAWEI det trubala God oldei lukinatbat ebribodi wanim olabat oldei dumbat. Im oldei luk detlot gudbala en nogudbala ting weya wi oldei dumbat.
Det gudbala wed im gibit wi laif, bat det nogudwan wed im meigim wi fil nogud insaid.
Im nogud blanga yu if yu nomo teiknodis langa yu dedi en mami, bat im gud if yu dum wanim dubala dalim yu.
Ola gudbala pipul garra abum loda ebrijing langa olabat haus, bat detlot nogudbala pipul garra lujim olabat ebrijing wen dei abum trabul.
Detlot sabibala pipul oldei go en spredimatbat sabibala wed, bat detlot silibala pipul nomo dum lagijat, najing.
YAWEI nomo laigim detlot ofring weya detlot nogudbala pipul oldei gibitbat, bat im oldei gudbinji langa detlot trubala pipul weya oldei preipreibat.
YAWEI nomo laigim detlot nogudbala pipul hu oldei dumbat ola nogudbala ting, bat im laigim detlot hu oldei dumbat ola gudbala ting.
Detlot pipul hu nomo dumbat ola rait ting garra git panish, bat detlot pipul hu nomo wandim enibodi blanga streitinimap olabat garra dai.
Wal YAWEI sabi ebrijing langa det pleis weya ola dedwan pipul oldei jidan en im sabi blanga detlot pipul hu stil jidan laibala, en wanim olabat oldei jinggabat.
Enibodi hu meigimbat fan langa enibodi, nomo laigim wen sambodi dalim im, im rong. Dei nomo askimbat sabibala pipul blanga album olabat.
Wen yu jidan brabli hepiwan, wal yu luk hepiwan, bat wen yu jidan sedwan, wal yu luk brabli sedwan.
Pipul hu wandim jidan brabli sabibala oldei wandim len mowa blanga dum ola sabibala ting, bat detlot silibala pipul kipgon dumbat silibala ting.
Ola powan pipul oldei abumbat adtaim, bat detlot pipul hu oldei jidan hepiwan garra jidan gudbalawei.
Im mobeda yu jidan powan en shoum rispek langa YAWEI den yu jidan ritjwan en abum loda trabul.
Im mobeda yu dagadagat difrinwan daga garram detlot pipul hu laigim yu den blanga dagat bif garram detlot pipul hu nomo laigim yu.
Enibodi hu gitwail kwikbala oldei meigim mowa trabul, bat detlot pipul hu jidan kwaitbala garra album pipul jidan gudwei.
If yu jidanbat leisiwan yu garra abum trabul eniweya yu go, bat if yu jidan trubalawei wal yu kaan abum eni trabul.
Detlot biginini weya sabi ola gudbala ting oldei meigim olabat dedi jidan brabli hepiwan, bat detlot nogudbala biginini heidim olabat mami.
Detlot pipul hu nomo sabi ola gudbala ting laigim dumbat ola silibala ting, bat detlot pipul hu jidan sabibala oldei dum ola rait ting.
Wen sambodi meigim im ronwan plen wal det plen kaan hepin, najing, bat if bigmob pipul album im meigim plen tharran garra hepin.
Sambala pipul oldei tokbek garram gudbala wed langa det rait taim en dei meigim ebribodi brabli gudbinji.
Detlot pipul hu jidan sabibala oldei wok langa det roud weya gibit laif. Dei nomo wok langa det roud weya garra meigim olabat dai.
Wal YAWEI garra bitsimap detlot haus blanga detlot praudbala pipul, bat im garra maindimbat detlot ebrijing blanga detlot widogel.
YAWEI nomo laigim detlot pipul hu oldei jinggabat nogudbalawei, bat im oldei gudbinji langa detlot pipul hu oldei toktokbat garram kainbala wed.
Detlot pipul hu oldei gridi blanga olkain ting garra meigim trabul blanga im ronwan femili olabat, bat detlot pipul hu nomo gajim mani blanga dum rong ting garra jidan laibala longtaim.
Ola gudbala pipul oldei jinggabat basdam bifo dei ensim sambodi, bat detlot nogudbala pipul ensimbek streidawei en dei meigim trabul.
YAWEI kaan lisin langa detlot wikitwan pipul, bat im oldei lisin langa detlot gudbala pipul hu oldei preipreibat en hu dumbat ola rait ting.
Wen yu luk enibodi garram hepiwan feis im meigim yu hepi du, en gudbala nyus meigim yu jidan gudbinjiwei.
If yu lisin wen enibodi streitinimap yu, wal yu garra jidan mowa sabibala.
If yu nomo laigim len blanga ola gudwan ting wal yu garra ardim yu ronselp, bat if yu teiknodis langa ola gudbala wed wal yu garra jidan sabibala.
Yu garra shoum rispek langa YAWEI en im garra titjim yu blanga sabi mowa blanga ola klebawan ting. If yu wandim pipul blanga preisimbat yu, wal yu garra jidan lobala en nomo laigim miselp.
